description: Two-way FHIR R4 sync with an external server (hospital, personal health record) via SMART-on-FHIR. Pulls remote Observations, encounters, documents, medications, allergies and immunizations into the Biomarker Engine and pushes local Observations out. The base URL is instance-configured; outbound calls ride the polite runtime's SSRF guard (per-hop revalidation) without a manifest-declared domain scope.
author: Health Assistant Core
